svg.aria-label: How Kanwal answers a team member's question: an encrypted connection from the browser, five security checks, an answer found only in sources the person can open, and a reply to that person only. Data stays in a private, encrypted space per company. Jira and Confluence are read-only, and the AI receives only the question and approved passages.
